verdict.comment: It's a puzzle and a chance is taken that PARADIAS can carry on his good work from the AW at 1m2f-1m4f. Almosh'her is second choice.

comments.almoshher: 121 in tight AW finishes for Charlie Fellowes; clear potential, particularly if settling
comments.darkmoonrising: Has a mixed York record (one C&D win) and is back up the weights after some good AW runs
comments.kingscode: Creditable third of five at Lingfield (11.6f, good to firm) on Saturday but needs better
comments.lapulga: Usually front-runner; creditable sequence extended to reappearance and he should go well
comments.marhabathechamp: York winner but not in his disappointing 2024 season; cheekpieces are enlisted
comments.maxmayhem: Won stylishly at Meydan; put in his place off career-high mark in Britain 15 days later
comments.naqeeb: Last season proved very disappointing; left William Haggas for 170,000gns last October
comments.paradias: 1m1f winner at Glorious Goodwood (good to firm)  and did well at up to 1m4f on AW
comments.plagedehavre: Did well on AW this winter before pulled up (helped set strong pace) on latest outing
comments.seehector: Ran on well from the back when third of seven in a steadily run Meydan Group 2 at 1m4f
comments.stressfree: Probably stays 1m4f; has never raced on firmer than good but otherwise has each-way appeal
comments.thereverend: All starts have been on softer than good; lightly raced and may well do better this term

races.raceComment: darkmoonrising is marginally preferred with a score of 56.7%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over lapulga. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Key attributes include optimal distance, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Judged on the strength of his C&D novice effort, ANOTHER ABBOT (nap) is particularly interesting. Invincible Crown is second pick.

comments.anotherabbot: Solid third (split subsequent winners) in C&D novice event when last seen; respected
comments.cressidawildes: Rather exposed; chance of doubling her tally depends on the effects of new headgear
comments.diomedduke: Ended his 2yo campaign with respectable effort in Newmarket sales race; one to consider
comments.fiorellaprincess: Consistent sort; solid chance, assuming she takes to first-time headgear
comments.forager: May rebound with Windsor reappearance under her belt; consistent otherwise in handicaps
comments.invinciblecrown: Interesting back at this lower level, having won sole attempt in a Class 5 handicap
comments.nightbird: Prevailed narrowly at Wolverhampton last time; back up just 2lb; may remain competitive
comments.roguebullet: Came up short last time but gives the impression this return to 5f is worth exploring
comments.styleking: The way he shaped last time suggests this drop to 5f will suit; not ruled out
comments.tempeststar: May improve back at 5f on handicap debut and second start for new yard; check the betting

races.raceComment: nightbird is marginally preferred with a score of 45.1%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over roguebullet. Won 1 of last 5 starts. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Good To Firm ground from 5 attempts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter, potentially favoring the selection's run style, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Sisters In The Sky is high on the list but AGENT MAYFAIR has been in good form on AW and gets the vote now switched to turf.

comments.agentmayfair: In good form on AW; dam effective on firm ground; could find this setting up nicely
comments.banana: 48th time lucky when making all over 5f here last week; unexposed on fast turf; contender
comments.bigtimerascal: Exposed maiden; drops in class today and not discounted
comments.bonnypower: 5f AW winner in Ireland; modest form for this yard last year; check the betting
comments.himawari: Bits of form on AW this year and has shown promise on fast turf; not a solid option though
comments.katar: 38-race maiden; low-key seasonal return (after wind op) ten days ago; easy to swerve
comments.midnightflame: Exposed maiden; capable of winning at this level and she can step forward from her return
comments.milliethemollie: 0-15 for this yard in 2024; conditions should be fine but she has an absence to overcome
comments.rusheenboy: Two AW wins to his name; lower turf mark but with justification at this stage
comments.savalas: C&D winner; second over 5f here (4lb better off with winner Banana today) last week
comments.sistersinthesky: Fourth behind two of these over 5f last week; longer trip will suit; one to take seriously

races.raceComment: savalas is marginally preferred with a score of 50.8%, holding clear edges in better suited by conditions and stronger recent form and superior course form over rusheenboy. Placed in 2 of last 6 starts, though unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: Eightthreeone deserves to be popular after his debut display here but MEHMAS AIR FORCE shaped nicely at Leicester.

comments.buenosdias: Favourite when close third at Brighton but faded into 6th of 12 at Beverley 12 days later
comments.dandyorton: 6,000euros yearling by Dandy Man; third foal; dam unraced sister to 1m/Listed 1m4f winner
comments.eightthreeone: Gave 8-15 favourite plenty to think about in four-runner maiden here (5f, firm) last week
comments.malingatheslinga: 40-1, slowly away, green and always detached at Beverley (5f, good) three weeks ago
comments.mehmasairforce: 28-1 for maiden at Leicester (5f, good) 18 days ago, held up and running on into 5th of 15
comments.squadronleader: 35,000euros yearling; Mehmas half-brother to 6f-10.5f winner Qaader (inc 2yo; RPR 112)
comments.touchwoodnwhistle: Eightthreeone showed a lot more dash but this one was getting the hang of things in 3rd

races.raceComment: eightthreeone is marginally preferred with a score of 19.5%. Going is a significant concern - yet to win on Firm ground from 1 attempts. Key attributes include improving, though step up in class and unfavorable draw and inconsistent profile need consideration.

verdict.comment: A chance is taken on BLUE HERO now he returns to the scene of his eight wins, with Jimmy Mark respected following his C&D win.

comments.bluehero: Well beaten on reappearance but he can step forwards now back at his favoured track.
comments.douglasdc: 1-42 but he's been placed in each of last three starts with the blinkers on; place claims.
comments.endofastorm: C&D winner; entitled to come on for her recent comeback and has a chance dropped in grade.
comments.hawkjet: Failed to build on her Salisbury third last year; drops back in trip for seasonal debut.
comments.jimmymark: Made a winning reappearance over C&D 40 days ago; respected following a 3lb rise.
comments.sneakyblinder: Won twice at Kempton but he was well beaten in March when last seen on the Flat.
comments.twoplustwo: Posted his best effort when winning at Salisbury (1m6f) last time; carries a 5lb penalty.

verdict.comment: Preference is for DONSO STAR (nap), who showed some good form last spring and is taken to build on last month's reappearance 4th here.

comments.beattheretreat: Won in first-time cheekpieces in February; well beaten twice since but now goes in a visor
comments.bleulagune: Close fourth on handicap debut at Kelso; there can be hope she'll continue to progress
comments.donsostar: Went close over C&D last April and returned from absence with fair recent fourth over C&D
comments.imtootired: Out of form over fences but perhaps the return to hurdles will give him a boost
comments.kinggoldboy: Goes handicapping in first-time cheekpieces off basement mark, but has shown very little
comments.larkfieldlusive: 0-19 but in pretty good heart this spring and runner-up last time; might not be far away
comments.malangen: Four-time course winner who returns from a break on a handy mark and could go well
comments.millyupdahilly: Fair fifth of 13 in 0-120 at Ayr last time and could be involved now dropping into a 0-100
comments.princenino: Went close at Newcastle in January but hasn't performed to same level on his 4 runs since
comments.ricketygate: Back on the scoresheet at Carlisle and could give another good account back up 4lb; chance

races.raceComment: ricketygate is marginally preferred with a score of 53.2%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over malangen. Won 2 of last 6 starts. verdict.comment: Back up in trip, SHADOWFAX OF ROHAN could well build on his latest effort and get off the mark. Golden Moonshake is second pick.

comments.followcharlie: Back in form with three placed efforts this spring, runner-up at Perth latest; solid
comments.goldenmoonshake: Southern raider; ran encouragingly at Hereford most recently; possibilities
comments.intertwine: May improve now handicapping at an ordinary level; third run for new yard
comments.ivynator: Remains a maiden over hurdles and needs to raise his game
comments.maillotblanc: Record is only 1-21; needs help from the new headgear
comments.notinkansas: Successful in this race last year and warrants respect off a workable mark
comments.shadowfaxofrohan: Promising third at Perth last month on handicap debut; interesting back up in distance
comments.theirshegoes: Took a heavy fall last time; remains to be seen whether her confidence is dented
comments.treadsoftlynow: Gained her wins at 2m/2m2f; still needs to prove she's effective over further

races.raceComment: notinkansas is marginally preferred with a score of 53.6%, holding clear edges in stronger recent form over followcharlie. Won 1 of last 6 starts. Could develop into tactical affair with no obvious pace-setter. Key attributes include optimal distance, though inconsistent profile need consideration.
